$overlayKitImports: Desktop surfaces import overlay primitives straight from the kit PACKAGE
is appended here. This is the one active behaviour the deleted desktop fork
carried, now expressed as config rather than a second implementation.
Without it EVERY such host vanishes from the registry. In THIS tree that is
caught loudly (the host is allow-listed, so --check fails on the now-stale
allow-list entry, exit 1) — but only for hosts that are wired or allow-listed:
a host that is neither would simply disappear and the gate would pass. So the
fail-open shape is real but not currently realized; do not remove the key.
